task_description:
# Enhanced TV Navigation System

Implement a best-in-class remote-first navigation system for Apple TV and Android TV that handles focus management, D-pad navigation, long-press actions, and spatial navigation intuitively.

## Rationale
Poor TV navigation is the #1 complaint about Stremio (pain-1-1) and a major weakness of Kodi's mobile/TV experience. This is a high-opportunity market gap (gap-1) that Nuvio can dominate. The discovery document confirms TV navigation is actively being improved.

## User Stories
- As a TV user, I want to navigate the entire app with my remote so that I never need to use a keyboard or phone
- As an Apple TV user, I want the app to feel as native as the Apple TV+ app in terms of navigation
- As an Android TV user, I want long-press on the select button to show quick actions like 'Add to List'

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All UI elements are focusable and reachable via D-pad navigation
- [ ] Focus states are clearly visible with appropriate visual feedback
- [ ] Long-press on remote triggers context menus for quick actions
- [ ] Spatial navigation remembers last focused item when navigating between screens
- [ ] Back button behavior is consistent and predictable across all screens
- [ ] Voice search via TV remote is supported where available
- [ ] No focus traps or unreachable UI elements exist
